descByPlatform.chatgpt: Low-Angle Hero Lifestyle Product Photograph for CANVAS CITY sneakers autumn-sidewalk editorial. Composition: Low-Angle Hero 12° upward tilt, Rule of Thirds lead shoe 33% x 58% y, Leading Lines along sidewalk seam, subject 46% of frame, Dutch Angle 4°. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 45mm LS at f/4.5, 1/400s, ISO 400, handheld monopod. Material physics: canvas weft-warp weave, gum rubber matte micro-pebble, wet concrete specular puddle, maple leaf vein translucency. Color grade: Capture One Warm-06 LUT grain 10 +0.1 EV. Palette: cream canvas #E9DFD0 30%, gum rubber #C9A96A 18%, concrete grey #A8A6A0 28%, maple orange #D05A2A 16%, shadow #1F1A14 8%. References: Kinfolk walking editorial, Monocle footwear, Adidas Originals lookbook. Exclude: harsh shadows, plastic sheen, blown highlights, cluttered props, color cast.
